# Convert MKV to MP4

- Route: `/tools/convert-mkv-to-mp4`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `video`
- Slug: `convert-mkv-to-mp4`

## Summary

Turn Matroska .mkv files into an MP4 that streams, uploads, and plays on devices that reject MKV. (Video tools)

## Details

MKV (Matroska) is a flexible container popular for high-quality video, but a lot of phones, browsers, smart TVs, and upload forms will not play it. Converting MKV to MP4 puts the video into a container those devices understand. Media Manipulator re-encodes to H.264 + AAC so the result plays and uploads cleanly.
### What it does
- Converts Matroska .mkv files to MP4.
- Locks the output to MP4 (H.264 + AAC) for broad device support.
- Adds yuv420p and +faststart so the MP4 streams and starts instantly.
- Trim an MKV episode or change its size before the MP4 is written.
### How to use it
1. Upload your MKV: Drop in a .mkv file.
2. Output is locked to MP4: MP4 is preset for this tool.
3. Convert: We move/transcode the video into an MP4.
4. Download: Save an MP4 that plays everywhere.
### Supported formats
- Input: mkv
- Output: mp4
- Output is locked to MP4 (H.264 + AAC, yuv420p, +faststart). The primary video and first audio track are kept.
### Technical details
- If the MKV already holds H.264 + AAC, the conversion is fast and visually lossless.
- We force yuv420p so the MP4 plays in Safari and on social platforms.
- MKV can carry many subtitle/audio tracks; the converter keeps the primary video and first audio track.
### Use cases
- Phone & TV playback: Make an MKV play on a device that rejects it.
- Upload to the web: Turn an MKV into an MP4 a site will accept.
- Editor handoff: Import an MP4 into editors that struggle with MKV.
- Standardize a library: Bring MKV downloads in line with your MP4 collection.
### FAQ
Q: How do I convert MKV to MP4?
A: Upload your .mkv file and click convert — the output is already set to MP4.
Q: Does converting MKV to MP4 lose quality?
A: If the MKV already uses H.264, the result is visually lossless at High quality. Otherwise it is a normal lossy re-encode.
Q: What happens to extra audio or subtitle tracks?
A: The converter keeps the main video and the first audio track. For multi-track needs, reach out and we can look at track selection.
Q: Why will my MKV not play?
A: Many phones, TVs, browsers, and sites do not support the MKV container even when the codecs inside are common.
